verdict.rationale: Sentry's platform docs say that for use cases not covered by its SDKs, there is documentation on how to report events yourself. The docs also describe a large community-supported SDK ecosystem, and a community user notes that the fully open-source code lets them see exactly how integrations work. Together this shows the ingestion path is open to custom and compatible clients. Missing for 10: no protocol specifics in the evidence (event/envelope payload format, endpoint and DSN authentication details), and no hands-on report of building a custom client against the protocol.
